ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake Gravship Crush Landing
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
GRAVSHIP_LANDING_CRUSH_1. Owner ruling, 2026-09-05: a gravship that size will never find a perfectly clear landing site, so small barriers and blockages (walls, furniture, rubble, anything without canLandGravshipOn) are crushed rather than refusing the landing — only a natural rock roof (major mountain), the map's own designated landing-blocker zones, and terrain that cannot take Substructure (deep water, lava) still refuse. Also lets the gravship launch even with a thruster physically blocked, since the grav engine lifts vertically before thrust is needed.
Two small Harmony patches, both re-derived from the live decompiled vanilla mechanism (RimWorld.Designator_MoveGravship.IsValidCell, RimWorld.WorldComponent_GravshipController.InitiateLanding, RimWorld.CompGravshipThruster.Blocked) rather than copied from a guess — see the source comments for exactly which vanilla branch each patch changes and which ones are left untouched.
